changes: First release: a track machine that plays a Flex sample like an 8-bit home computer and its tracker software.
STCH sets the length in percent and CYL the cycle in samples, so PTCH changes the pitch and STCH the length. STR can make it a pitch shift.
RATE stores the sample at a tracker's note rates, BITS at 4 to 16 bits, and LED adds a fixed lowpass. STCH, CYL and RATE take locks and LFOs.
Known issue: stock's RATE, RTRG and RTIM are not on an Amiga track, so it cannot play in reverse, and a sliced track is not stretched.
